_what: One place to manage what repo sits on which object in the room.
_how: Under pins, add a line per repo: "repo-name": "spot". A repo listed here shows up in the room even without any github topic. "repo-name": "hide" keeps a repo out of the room entirely. Repos not listed here still work the old way: topic 'room' to appear, topic 'on-couch' (etc.) to pin. This file always wins over topics.
_note: The page reads github's public api, so private repos can't appear.
